problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select packages for a shipment. The available packages are:
* Package A: volume 49 cubic feet, revenue $115
* Package B: volume 19 cubic feet, revenue $284
* Package C: volume 39 cubic feet, revenue $223
* Package D: volume 31 cubic feet, revenue $208
* Package E: volume 39 cubic feet, revenue $129
* Package F: volume 2 cubic feet, revenue $10
* Package G: volume 48 cubic feet, revenue $103
* Package H: volume 20 cubic feet, revenue $269
The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 172 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully included or excluded from the shipment.
